column5: role_is_idle keeps a sidekick whose unit is still under verification (pair.json .verifying); assess drops its redundant role test; archive table gains the row
stop names and skips a role whose entry holds no thread (starts_on_prompt), in the trio loop and pair's own stop; no fresh thread just to be told STOP

stop_role relays STOP to a working Amp role through the master like steer (print_relay shared in commands/relay.py, send-stop relay-pending event, fallback to the queued prompt); new kitchen stop relay test

joo finding 1: the pair's own stop no longer falls into the wait's report fallback after a relay; the relay decision moves from stop_role into relay_stop, called by the pair's and the trio's stop loops on a working role

joo finding 2: a relay sent into a turn that has ended no longer answers 'delivered' — in_turn_at requires the thread to still be in the turn the relay went into, so a stop in a later turn is relayed anew

fixes for the joo re-run on the final range (run 2026-11-20T17-11-18-390Z-0e627252): 7e0a6ec (finding A, medium, execution 9feb15c6cb7989ac224b612a) — the trio/kitchen stop's closing lines still named the newest report after a relayed STOP, which the pair's stop suppresses; the stop now tracks the roles whose STOP was relayed and leaves out the line of the role that owns it (sidekick's report, consultant's advice), waited stops print both lines unchanged so the Herdr/Rex goldens hold; pinned by the trio stop test which now writes a report first and asserts 'report:' not in out, proven failing before the fix. 25992ca (finding B, low, execution d4cae522ccce6cfaba1887c1) — print_relay's 'and record' on the too-large branch is dead (Amp.relay returns 'too-large' only with a size dict); dropped, no testable behaviour change. SPEC regenerated. Gates: -k stop 40 passed, -k relay 12 passed, -k threads_archive 1 passed, ruff format/check, uv check, spec_gen --check all clean.
